About Layan

Layan is the beach area on Phuket's west coast north of Bang Tao, in Choeng Thale, Thalang district; Layan Beach borders a national park. Projects listed here are described as located on or very close to Layan Beach or Layan Bay: pool-villa communities (Aileen Villas Layan, Pavara Vhana Collection), the branded beachfront condominium Kiara Reserve Residences next to the Anantara Layan resort, and the sea-view Ayana Heights, about 1.4 km (2 minutes by car) from Layan Beach in the project data.

This is the premium end of our catalogue, with advertised starting prices from about THB 4.5 million for Ayana Heights up to THB 98 million. Projects that are only near Layan Beach, such as Layan Green Park, are listed under their primary location (Cherng Talay) and mention Layan as a nearby area.

Why buyers choose Layan

  • Unspoilt beach next to a national park
  • Low-density surroundings
  • Close to Bang Tao, Laguna and the airport
  • Mix of resort condos and luxury villas

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Bang Tao · Nai Yang

Lifestyle and amenities

Layan is calm, with a few beach restaurants and resorts. Daily shopping and dining are in nearby Bang Tao, Laguna and Boat Avenue.

Beaches and surroundings

Layan Beach is a peaceful, partly tree-lined beach next to Sirinat National Park, known for sunsets and horse riding on the sand. It is good for swimming in the dry season.

Rental demand in Layan

Layan appeals to holiday guests who want quiet surroundings and to long-stay residents who still want Bang Tao services nearby. It is a smaller, more niche market than Bang Tao.

Short-term holiday rentals

Guests looking for nature and calm; demand follows the dry season.

Long-term rentals

Families and professionals who want space and quiet within reach of schools and shops.

Suitable property types

Resort condos with good facilities; pool villas.

Advantages and limitations

Advantage: natural setting and limited development near the national park. Limitations: fewer local amenities on foot; you need a car or scooter.

General market observations, not verified statistics. No rental income or occupancy is guaranteed; developer-advertised returns are not market results.

Rental and investment in Layan

Buyers choose Layan for its quiet, natural setting close to the services of Bang Tao. New large-scale projects are adding supply, so look at location within Layan and the distance to the beach.

Typical investor profiles

Lifestyle buyers, villa owners and condo buyers in resort-style projects.

Risks to consider

Large new projects competing for tenants; long construction schedules for phased developments.

Ownership costs

Common fees, sinking fund, management, maintenance and insurance.

Layan: frequently asked questions

Where is Layan Beach?

Layan Beach is at the northern end of Bang Tao Bay on Phuket's west coast, next to Sirinat National Park.

Is Layan quieter than Bang Tao?

Yes. Layan has far fewer bars and restaurants on the beach, while Bang Tao's services are a few minutes away by car.

How far is Layan from Phuket airport?

Our project data gives about 15 km to Phuket International Airport, usually 20 to 25 minutes by car.

Is Layan good for families?

Layan suits families who want a calm beach and space, with schools and shopping in nearby Bang Tao and Laguna.

Can you swim at Layan Beach?

Yes, in the dry season. As elsewhere on the west coast, check the flags from about May to October.

How much does property in Layan cost?

Advertised starting prices for projects in Layan run from ฿4,500,000 to ฿98,000,000 (5 of 5 projects publish a price). These are lowest advertised prices; ask us to confirm current availability.

Prices are advertised starting prices and are not guaranteed. Information is general and is not legal or investment advice.
